_help: Treatment menu. To change a price, type it in 'price' (for example "£180" or "from £150"). Leave price empty to send visitors to the live price on the booking page. 'confirmed': false keeps a treatment out of the live site. Never add prices, offers or product names to anything marked 'prescriptionOnly'.
note: Live prices, times and availability are always shown on the booking page.

categories.name: Lips
categories.intro: Lip treatments are planned around the shape you already have. Natasha will talk you through what is realistic for your lips before anything is booked in.

treatments.name: Lip enhancement
treatments.summary: Dermal filler used to add definition, balance or a little volume, in amounts planned with you at consultation.
treatments.source: Lip treatments are the focus of the TikTok profile and the Level Up Lips Masterclass.

treatments.name: Russian lip technique
treatments.summary: A filler technique that concentrates on lifting and shaping the lip profile. Natasha will advise whether it suits your lips.
treatments.source: Mentioned on the Facebook page 'So Subtle Aesthetics' (not yet confirmed as the official page).

categories.name: Skin
categories.intro: Treatments that work on the quality of the skin itself. Most are recommended as a short course, which Natasha will plan with you.

treatments.name: Microneedling
treatments.summary: Fine, controlled micro-channels are made in the skin as part of a skin-quality treatment, often chosen for texture and fine lines.

treatments.name: Microneedling with polynucleotides
treatments.summary: Microneedling combined with a polynucleotide product applied during the same session.
treatments.source: TikTok @sosubtleaesthetics posts on microneedling with polynucleotides.

treatments.name: Polynucleotides
treatments.summary: An injectable skin treatment often chosen for the delicate under-eye area. Small raised bumps at the injection points are normal straight afterwards and settle on their own.
treatments.source: TikTok @sosubtleaesthetics posts on polynucleotides, fine lines and dark circles, and on post-treatment bumps.

treatments.name: Skin boosters
treatments.summary: Injectable hydration treatments for skin quality.

categories.name: Face
categories.intro: Facial treatments are always consultation-led. Natasha will only recommend what suits your face and what you would like to achieve, and she will tell you if she thinks a treatment is not right for you.

treatments.name: Facial dermal filler
treatments.summary: Dermal filler for areas such as the cheeks, chin or jawline, planned to keep your features in proportion.
treatments.source: Fresha directory listing (category data, not confirmed by the business).

treatments.name: Consultation for lines and wrinkles
treatments.summary: A face-to-face consultation to talk through lines and wrinkles and the options that may suit you, including their risks, alternatives and the choice of no treatment.
treatments.source: Anti-wrinkle injections appear in Fresha category data. These are prescription-only medicines, so the website promotes the consultation only: no product name, price or offer.
